[library]
source-dir = "src"

scope: Key/value configuration input. The main creates and reads a tiny INI-style file with a section, comment, integer, double, logical and string, verifies known values and deletes it. A checksum-guarded manifest correction changes the invalid one-element library array into a library table; Fortran sources are unchanged. Other I/O modules and malformed-input handling are not covered.
compatibility_edits: The original [[library]] array is rendered as the required [library] table. The original manifest and exact checksum-guarded replacement are retained; no Fortran source changed.
